## Frequently asked questions[](https://www.pipedrive.com/en/pricing)

*   ### What is CRM pricing and how is it determined? What factors affect CRM software cost?

CRM pricing refers to the cost of implementing and using [customer relationship management software](https://www.pipedrive.com/en/crm/fundamentals). The price is determined by factors like number of users, features included in the software, integrations and level of support provided by CRM companies.   
*   ### How much does a CRM cost on average?

CRM costs vary widely depending on the CRM company and features included. On average, the typical cost of CRM software ranges from less than a hundred to several hundred dollars per user per year, with some enterprise-level solutions costing even more. To find the best CRM software prices, research and compare CRM providers based on their pricing plans and features. Pipedrive offers different solutions at price points to match users’ requirements. Learn more on our [CRM price comparison](https://www.pipedrive.com/crm-comparison) pages.   
*   ### Can my co-workers join my free trial?

Yes, you can invite as many people as you want to join your Pipedrive trial. Simply click on your profile in the top right corner of your screen and select “Add more users” from the drop-down menu.   
*   ### Will my data be safe?

Protecting your business data is one of our highest priorities. Learn more about our rigorous [security and privacy](https://www.pipedrive.com/features/privacy-security)standards.   
*   ### What is an add-on?

Add-ons are additional Pipedrive tools that you can add to any plan.   
*   ### What’s the difference between annual and monthly billing?

The difference is [how often you pay](https://support.pipedrive.com/en/article/what-is-the-difference-between-annual-and-monthly-billing-in-pipedrive) your subscription fee. With monthly billing, you will be charged on the same day each month. With annual billing, you are charged once for the whole year.   
*   ### Which payment methods do you accept?

There are [different ways](https://support.pipedrive.com/en/article/what-are-the-accepted-payment-methods-for-pipedrive) to pay for Pipedrive including major credit cards, debit cards and PayPal. Your payment options depend on the country you live in.   
*   ### How can I contact customer support?

Our friendly support team is ready to help out. [Here’s how to get in touch.](https://support.pipedrive.com/en/contact-us)   
*   ### What are the prices associated with CRM?

As well as the cost of the customer relationship management software itself, which differs based on pricing tier, some providers also charge users for implementation, setup, training, data migration, support and more. You may also be able to purchase credits to get access to more features or more access to the features already on your plan. Try to find a CRM that’s transparent about its pricing. Pipedrive has no hidden costs, making it an excellent choice for anyone with a fixed budget.   
*   ### What does it cost to implement a CRM?

The cost of implementing a CRM varies based on factors such as business size, software choice, user count, customization and integration needs. On-premises setups usually have higher upfront costs. Some CRM providers charge users for implementation. If you choose Pipedrive, implementation is free when you sign up for a pricing plan that’s over $400 a year. Costs differ widely, so a thorough evaluation is essential for an accurate estimate.

### What are the main pricing plans for Sales Cloud?

Choose from Starter Suite, Pro Suite, Core, Advanced, and Max — each with increasing levels of AI, automation, integration, and customization. Want help finding the right fit? [Request a call](https://www.salesforce.com/company/contact-us/?d=cta-body-promo-274) with a Salesforce account executive to learn more.

### How does Sales Cloud pricing work?

Sales Cloud pricing follows a per-user, per-month subscription model. You pay a monthly fee for each user who needs access. Pricing varies by edition, with each offering different features and levels of functionality to fit your business needs.

### Is there a free version of Sales Cloud?

Salesforce offers a free 30-day trial for all Sales Cloud editions, with simple setup so you can get started quickly and explore key sales capabilities. If you'd like to explore an all-in-one CRM experience across sales, service, marketing, commerce, and Slack, you can also start a [free 30-day trial of Starter Suite](https://www.salesforce.com/small-business/free-trial/starter-suite/?d=pb) for up to 10 users.

### How much does Starter Suite cost?

[Starter Suite](https://www.salesforce.com/small-business/starter/) costs $25 USD per user, per month. It's an all-in-one CRM designed for small businesses, bringing together sales, service, marketing and commerce tools. Plus, it includes Slack at no extra cost for seamless collaboration.

### What's changing with Sales Cloud editions?

Core, Advanced, and Max bring business apps, AI, trusted data, security, analytics, collaboration, and expert support together in one edition. Agentforce, Slack, Tableau, Data 360 and Premier Success are now included in every edition.

### How do the new editions compare to the ones I have today?

Core replaces Enterprise Edition, Advanced replaces Unlimited Edition, and Max replaces Agentforce 1 Edition. Each new edition includes more value and bundles everything businesses need for agentic transformation. Your Account Executive can help you compare options and pick the right time to make the move.

### Which edition is right for my business?

*   **Max:**Give every person in your business AI without limits, and the governance to bring in any other agent, securely, with unmetered Agentforce, Coworker and 2.75 million Flex Credits.
*   **Advanced:** Offload more to AI agents, with the insight and control to trust what it does with the full security suite (Backup & Recover, Security Center, Data Detect, and Archive) and 1 million Flex Credits.
*   **Core:** Start getting value from AI fast, right where your team already works, with expert guidance from Premier Success and 500K Flex Credits.

### I'm on Agentforce 1 Edition today. What changes if I move to Max?

Max delivers nearly 60% more value than Agentforce 1 Edition at the same price. Agentforce 1 Sales customers can move to Max with ease at no additional cost, with up to $500 in added value. Your account team can map your current licenses to Max and walk you through the upgrade.

### Are there upfront costs or additional fees?

Salesforce has all kinds of add-ons, apps, and additional products to help your company stay ahead in your industry. Call us at 1-800-664-9073 to discuss exactly what kind of products you’re looking to add and how we can help.

### What if my business priorities and product needs have changed?

We know things don’t always go according to plan, and we’re here and will try our best to support. Reach out to a sales representative at 1-800-664-9073 to discuss options.

### Do Salesforce products integrate with outside applications and systems?

In many cases, Salesforce products integrate directly with many outside applications and systems to help you connect your data. For those that don’t have built-in integration, like on-premises data sources, you can purchase licenses of MuleSoft, work with our integration partners, or use apps on AgentExchange.   
  
Talk to a sales representative to get an idea of what integration solution works best with the Salesforce products you use.

### What support and service packages are available?

We offer several advisory, adoption, and support plans to our customers. To learn more, visit [Success Cloud](https://www.salesforce.com/services/).

### How long are your contracts?

Most Salesforce products use annual contracts, but Salesforce subscription terms vary. Chat with a sales representative to discuss payment and billing options for your products.

### Can I upgrade at any time? Can I add more products later on?

You can add products or upgrade at any time, but some products may need to scale together. Reach out to our sales department at 1-800-664-9073 to see what works for your business.

This page is provided for information purposes only and subject to change. AI can be added to Core and above. Contact a sales representative for detailed pricing information.
